comment: Example of a high-priority constant core lock.
content:
EXAMPLE CORE LOCK (ALWAYS ACTIVE)

This is a demonstration of the required density and style.

- State the absolute rule first.
- List concrete forbidden behaviors.
- List required behaviors that protect character fidelity.
- End with a clear priority statement that this overrides softer defaults.

Never allow generic erotic templates to overwrite the defined personality.
name: Core - Example Lock
